findings.title: IDS checker applicability never matches IFC subtypes → COMPLIANT with unchecked elements
findings.description: _matches_applicability uses substring `entity_filter not in element_type`. Standard COBie/LOD helpers register applicability as 'IfcElement', but BIM elements are typed IfcDoor/IfcWall/IfcSlab — 'IfcElement' is not a substring of those names, so every Component/Element requirement is skipped. check_model then sets status='COMPLIANT' when fail_count==0. Empty models and MATERIAL/ATTRIBUTE/RELATION requirement types (returned as NOT_APPLICABLE) also yield COMPLIANT with zero FAILs.
findings.impact: Non-compliant BIM deliveries (doors/walls missing required COBie Name/TypeName, empty models, material-only specs) are marked COMPLIANT and can pass automated handover/IDS gates.
attack_path: Create COBie spec via create_standard_cobie_spec() (Component reqs apply to entity=IfcElement).
Submit model with IfcDoor/IfcWall elements missing COBie_Component properties (or empty element list).
_matches_applicability skips all IfcElement rules; only IfcSpace-like exact substring matches run.
check_model returns status=COMPLIANT / fail_count=0 → delivery accepted.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not ifc-qto webhook RCE or prior Innovative clash fail-open. New IDS gate on leftover ids-checker applicability/inheritance logic.
key_snippets: if entity_filter not in element_type: return False

findings.title: ConstructionEmailSender opens attacker-controlled attachment paths and SMTP-exfiltrates file bytes
findings.description: generate_rfi_response_email passes rfi.attachments through to email_data. ConstructionEmailSender.send does open(attachment_path,'rb') with no root jail, then MIME-attaches and server.sendmail(...). Integration example loads RFI fields from Excel — an attacker who can influence the attachments column (or any agent tool arg) points at /etc/passwd, .env, or SSH keys. Modern CPython blocks Subject/To CRLF header injection (HeaderParseError), but the file-read→email chain succeeds.
findings.impact: Arbitrary local file read and exfiltration to attacker-chosen SMTP recipients (to/cc lists).
attack_path: Poison RFI log Excel attachments cell (or tool arg) with absolute path e.g. /var/secrets/api.env.
Pipeline builds RFIResponse(attachments=[path]) → generate_rfi_response_email.
ConstructionEmailSender.send open()s the path, base64-attaches contents, sendmail to recipients.
Attacker receives secret material as email attachment.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not report XSS or n8n webhook RCE. Distinct curated email skill path-traversal→SMTP exfil chain.

findings.title: Lifecycle carbon calculator silently drops unknown assembly_id quantities → undercount
findings.description: calculate_project_carbon, when qty contains assembly_id, only adds carbon if assembly_id in self.assemblies; otherwise the quantity is ignored with no error/warning. Typos, BIM mapping misses, or attacker-supplied bogus assembly IDs zero-out whole structural packages. Default stage loop also includes Module D credits (often negative), further lowering totals when materials resolve.
findings.impact: Embodied-carbon reports / LEED-style intensity figures understate emissions; projects can appear Best Practice when major assemblies were never counted.
attack_path: Supply project quantities with assembly_id values not present in calculator.assemblies (typo or crafted).
calculate_project_carbon skips those rows; total_embodied_carbon omits them.
benchmark_comparison/_get_rating uses understated carbon_per_area → inflated green rating.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not CWICR assembly overwrite. New carbon undercount fail-open on leftover lifecycle-carbon-calculator.
key_snippets: elif stage == LifecycleStage.D: carbon = material.carbon_d * quantity

findings.title: Auto-estimate pricing rules treat missing QTO properties as satisfied conditions
findings.description: find_matching_rule only evaluates a condition when the property key exists on the QTO item. If BIM export omits material/thickness (common), material=='Drywall' and thickness_min checks are skipped and match stays True. Among matching rules, the most-conditioned rule wins — a Drywall rule with an extra thickness_min can beat a Masonry rule and price masonry walls at drywall rates. generate_estimate multiplies quantity * unit_cost with no unit conversion gate.
findings.impact: Systematic estimate underpricing (PoC: 1000 SF masonry wall → $45k drywall instead of $125k).
attack_path: Export QTO without material/thickness properties (or strip them).
Load rules including cheap Drywall (with thickness_min) and expensive Masonry.
find_matching_rule returns Drywall rule; generate_estimate prices at $45/SF.
Bid/budget exported via export_to_excel understates cost.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not CWICR quantity-matcher unit fail-open or cost-calculator regex. Distinct auto-estimate condition fail-open.

findings.title: Resource-based estimator skips missing resource codes → $0 component undercount
findings.description: calculate_work_item_cost loops norms and `continue`s when norm.resource_code not in self.resources, still returning status-like CostLineItem with reduced totals (no error). Incomplete price books or attacker-omitted resource rows drop labor/material/equipment lines to zero while the work item remains priced and rolled into calculate_estimate grand_total.
findings.impact: Estimates silently omit major BOM components (e.g. rebar/formwork) → underbid and downstream procurement shortfall.
attack_path: Load work item with norms referencing M001+M999; leave M999 out of resources DB.
calculate_work_item_cost / calculate_estimate continues past missing code.
Line total and grand_total exclude missing resource cost with no failure signal.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not erp SQLi or CWICR cost-calculator wrong-item. New resource-method silent skip undercount.
key_snippets: if norm.resource_code not in self.resources: continue

findings.title: BIM validation pipeline pass/fail ignores LOD report entirely
findings.description: BIMValidationPipeline.run computes lod_report = lod_validator.validate_model() but _evaluate_pass(bim_report, lod_report) only inspects bim_report['errors'] and bim_report['warnings']. LOD failures never flip passed=False. LODValidator also reports compliance=100 when an element type has zero instances (`if elements else 100`), vacuous success for missing categories.
findings.impact: Models failing LOD300/350 property/quantity requirements still get passed=True and can clear automated BEP delivery gates.
attack_path: Submit IFC that triggers LODValidator issues (missing Material/Type/quantities) but few BIMValidator ERRORs.
run() stores lod_validation with total_issues>0.
_evaluate_pass returns True because lod_report is unused.
Downstream treats result['passed'] as delivery OK.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Sibling of IDS applicability skip but distinct pipeline gate that discards LOD outcomes.
key_snippets: if self.config['fail_on_errors'] and bim_report['errors'] > 0: return False

findings.title: Input validators fail open on type mismatch / nonstandard inspection result → authorize processing
findings.description: FieldDataValidator only runs checks when type exactly equals 'daily_report'|'inspection'|'progress'. Wrong case ('Inspection'), typos, or omitted type leave is_valid=True with zero issues. Inspection result outside {pass,fail,conditional,not_applicable} is add_warning only — is_valid stays True. validate_pipeline_inputs skips unknown input_type keys. Documented callers gate with `if result.is_valid: process_estimate(...)` / return all_valid.
findings.impact: Forged or unchecked field/inspection payloads pass the validation gate and are authorized into downstream process_* / pipeline execution.
attack_path: Submit field_data with type='Inspection' or type omitted, or inspection result='APPROVED_FORGED'.
FieldDataValidator returns is_valid=True (no ERROR).
Caller process_estimate / validate_pipeline_inputs allows processing.
findings.why_not_duplicate: Not permit ISSUED forge. New curated input-validation fail-open that explicitly authorizes process_* gates.

near_misses: email-construction Subject/To/Cc CRLF header injection — blocked by modern email policy HeaderParseError on as_string(); attachment path remains the live HIGH.
xlsx-construction task name stored as cell value starting with '=' — classic Excel formula injection but no auto-open/VBA/workbook_open chain in skill.
rag-construction — in-memory only; _generate_answer simulated; no filesystem path traversal or tool/exec RCE sink.
llm-data-automation — prompts produce code for humans; no automatic exec/eval of LLM output.
airflow-dag — bash_command/dag_id/filepath interpolated into generated DAG source; operator-controlled builder API, not an untrusted ingress.
daily-report-generator requests.get — fixed OpenWeatherMap host; location only as q= param (not open SSRF).
ifc-qto-extraction n8n webhook Execute Command — already reported unauth webhook RCE; subprocess uses list argv (already noted CAD class).
unit-price-database-manager / historical-cost-analyzer LOCATION_FACTORS.get(..., 1.0) — soft unknown-location factor; weaker than estimate/carbon fail-opens.
estimate-builder validate() advisory only — does not block calculate_total; weaker than auto-estimate/resource skip.
lifecycle Module D credits alone — design-ambiguous whole-life inclusion; filed under stronger silent assembly skip.
bim-validation IDSValidator ET.parse — Python xml.etree does not resolve external entities by default (XXE near-miss).
resource-leveler — reports remaining overallocations; success=False when unresolved (not fail-open).
